entities.summary: Sir Isaac Wolfson, 1st Baronet was a Scottish businessman and philanthropist. He was managing director of the mail order business Great Universal Stores 1932–1947 and chairman 1947–1987. He joined the company as a merchandising controller in 1932, becoming joint managing director in the same year. The company was in trouble when he joined but he turned it round and made it into a very strong business and the principal source of his wealth. He also had other successful business ventures. He was succeeded by his son Leonard Wolfson.
